prespecified_regime_slices.rule: exact race date; report date blocks only when >=10 successful races
number of admitted PRE riders in race
max competition_score minus min competition_score within race; bucket boundaries frozen from the first 110-race descriptive corpus using tertiles and then held fixed for later races
set of parsed rider class labels present in race; no post-hoc merging except exact identical sets

reporting_rules: Report model and uniform metrics side by side for every eligible prespecified slice.
UNKNOWN or insufficient-n slices are not collapsed into favorable neighboring slices.
A slice failure is retained as negative evidence and cannot be removed from aggregate reporting.
No venue-specific, date-specific, class-specific, or score-spread-specific coefficient may be fitted from this 200R stability report.
No feature is promoted from exploratory ablation before a separately prespecified post-discovery confirmation batch.

decision_logic.continue_baseline: aggregate fixed-S0 remains better than uniform on all three primary metrics and no evidence of catastrophic calibration failure is hidden by aggregation
decision_logic.regime_warning: one or more adequately sized slices are materially worse than uniform on a primary probability metric

market_boundary.market_mispricing_not_inferred_from_prob: all_market_ticket probabilities remain downstream transforms of one ordered-top3 probability object
